title: Pasting of canonical section base comparisons and their restriction square
statement: For every finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions] and smooth section pairs [def-pur-section-restriction-data] over separated finite-type k-schemes, the canonical section baseComparison preserves identity and composite base changes, with the specified derived pullback constraints. For a commuting Cartesian change of an etale map of pairs, pulling back restriction and then applying the target baseComparison equals applying the source baseComparison and then the changed restriction. Base maps need not be flat. This states the cohomological square only; it does not assert Rees or normal-map naturality.

proof.text: For composition, apply section_baseChange_comp to the ordinary-etale section exchange. Expand baseComparison. Naturality of the pro-etale compositor moves the sourceComparison through it; pullComparison_comp and pullComparison_naturality identify the remaining site-comparison factors. Cancel the mapped inverse sourceComparison. Finite type over the field supplies Noetherianity, compactifications and invertible exponents.

For identity, specialize composition to two identity squares and identify their pasted square with the identity square by equality of its arrows. Apply the proved fixed-coefficient pullback left-unit coherence. Naturality of the pullback identity and cancellation of the invertible baseComparison give precisely the specified pullback identity component. This uses no normalization choice.

Identify sourceEtale = rho c with the inverse of sectionStructuralLocalityIso. Express the ambient left comparison by chart_comparison_formula and chart_comparison_ambient, cancelling self compactification comparisons. Its adjunction conjugate is c followed by rho and the exact-to-left-derived comparison, by conjugateEquiv_comp and conjugateEquiv_whiskerRight. The rho_canonical equation and the unique counit characterization of etale ambient locality identify this conjugate with locality. Cancel the exact-to-left-derived comparison. Substitution handles a named structural map equal to the composite. Pulling back along the section then identifies restrictionEtale with inverse section locality.

proof.text: Cartesian pasting gives the ambient etale pullback square from the two structural squares and the commuting ambient maps. Use structural_locality_baseChange and section_pullback_locality_comp, the proved helpers of SectionExceptionalFibreCoherence, together with naturality of the section pullback compositors. They give base-change naturality for forward section locality. Cancel the invertible locality maps on both sides to obtain the required ordinary-etale restriction square.

source.place: Already proved structural_locality_baseChange and section_pullback_locality_comp, accessed with a proof-only import all

proof.text: Expand restriction and baseComparison in the final square. Cancel the inverse source comparisons, apply pullComparison_naturality to restrictionEtale, and map the ordinary-etale square through comparisonUpperStar. Functoriality and cancellation give the stated equation. Assemble the identity, composition and restriction equations. No flatness, nonemptiness or positive dimension is used.
